Notes

Music used to be something you held. The sleeve was the first thing you saw, and the record came out of it. This is a small collection of covers I love, on a turntable you can actually play.

A 12-inch LP turns at 33⅓ revolutions per minute, so the platter here spins at that speed, and like a real one it takes a moment to get up to speed and to wind down. The arm follows the song as it plays.

Covers come from the Cover Art Archive, through MusicBrainz. The music plays through Spotify: a short preview, or the full album if you are signed in. Cover artwork belongs to its rights holders. The record labels and back sleeves are my own.
